observation_zh: 排程訊息在主要 Agent 仍完成同一輪安全保存時送達；沒有啟動第二個寫入者，也沒有重新執行已完成內容。此事件只記錄執行中防重複，不驗證閒置自動開發恢復。
observation_en: Scheduled message arrived while the primary agent was still completing the same turn safety save. No second writer or replay of completed work was started. This records active-execution duplicate avoidance, not idle automatic development resumption.
